response.justification: Bogdan has an extensive technical background with over 15 years of software engineering experience, including strong foundational work in developer tools, testing infrastructure, and mobile applications. However, his resume strictly reflects Individual Contributor (IC) roles (Senior/Staff SWE) and lacks any explicit experience in formal people management, performance reviews, or organizational leadership required for a mid-to-senior Level II Engineering Manager role.
strengths: Over 15 years of software development experience, significantly exceeding the 8-year minimum requirement.
Strong background in developer tools and testing infrastructure, demonstrated by his work at Altom, National Instruments, and personal open-source test frameworks.
Hands-on experience with mobile platforms (iOS, Apple TV) and CI/CD pipelines, directly aligning with the engineering productivity focus.
concerns: No explicitly stated experience in formal people management or conducting performance reviews, which is a core requirement for this role.
Lacks demonstrated experience leading large-scale organizational change or setting strategic department-level roadmaps.
Recent career trajectory is heavily focused on individual contribution across varied technical stacks rather than engineering leadership.
